mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate labor market strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rising > 50k in 1 month fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5%), a monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals improving labor conditions and triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5% and falls > 0.2pp in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 260 indicates elevated inflation that prompts central bank hawkishness, causing immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index reflects robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST rising > 5% and RSAFS rising > 0.5% in 1 month fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), a monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals aggressive policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in one month.
